digest.component_or_area: rebar init CLI and store mounting
propositions: rebar init currently creates an orphan divergent branch when a configured remote branch fetch fails or times out, despite the branch existing on the remote

the advertisement probe using git ls-remote must distinguish three states: remote unreachable/timed-out (fail closed), remote reachable but branch absent (bootstrap), and remote advertising branch (fetch and mount or fail nonzero)

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount without raising, while strict init paths fail closed with actionable diagnostics naming the remote, branch, and remediation
force_new_store override must apply only when reachability cannot be established; when remote is reachable, the flag has no effect and normal behavior proceeds
cold fetch retains 300-second bound; advertisement probe uses a separate shorter named timeout, both converting TimeoutExpired to exit code 124
